## Purpose

Describe the problem, the chosen boundary, and any platform-specific behavior.

## Verification

List exact automated and manual commands/results. Use synthetic data only.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and contains no unrelated formatting or generated files.
- [ ] Windows/Linux differences and unavailable evidence remain explicit.
- [ ] No UI or export text claims verified Internet reachability from a local binding.
- [ ] No telemetry, remote asset, hidden network destination, or privileged action was added.
- [ ] New untrusted input has bounds, cancellation, validation, and injection tests.
- [ ] Security/privacy documentation and threat model were updated where needed.
- [ ] Tests pass with warnings treated as errors.
- [ ] Screenshots/fixtures/reports contain no real endpoint, user, host, or customer data.
- [ ] Dependency, asset, license, and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` changes agree.
- [ ] I did not weaken a failing release/security check to make this PR pass.
